summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Allen had left Chicago for St. Louis, where he was expected to keep living, and that he and Joe Goss were both eager for a match.

metadata.notes: No masthead visible (page image is the clipping); date not verifiable. 1876 Dispatch items are filed as the St. Louis Evening Dispatch per rubric.

facts.fact: Allen left Chicago on Wednesday evening for St. Louis, not expected there before Monday; Fred Watkins thought he would continue to live in St. Louis
Allen and Joe Goss were both said to be anxious to meet, with arrangements for a fight expected soon

notes: Title typo 'Gross' should be 'Goss' (headline reads 'Tom Allen and Joe Goss'). Event date assumes the paper date 1876-04-28 (Friday), so Wednesday = April 26.
